note: Flags mark records to read first. Routing is decided by hand in the scope document; these reasons were written by another chapter's rubric.

records.title: Elder Care and Challenges of Family Caregivers in Iran
records.reason: Qualitative account of old-age support obligations downstream of fertility decline; upward transfers place it with C.3.f, not this chapter.

records.title: Understanding intergenerational dynamics and social support’s impact on health and well-being of older adults in South Asia: a scoping review
records.reason: Operative variable is upward intergenerational transfers and old-age support (Wall 1).

records.title: Impact of adult son migration on the health wellbeing of older parents and shifts in caregiving patterns: a study in India
records.reason: Operative variable is old-age support and intergenerational caregiving flows, with no fertility outcome.

records.title: Lithium-ion batteries and fertility in Africa
records.reason: Operative variable is child labour in mines raising household wealth — a wealth-flow mechanism (Wall 1).

records.title: Can Long-Term Care Insurance Change Eldercare Patterns? Evidence from China
records.reason: Operative variable is upward intergenerational support and old-age care, squarely the wealth-flows estimand.

records.title: Pensions and Fertility: Microeconomic Evidence
records.reason: Operative variable is old-age support substituting for transfers from children, which is the wealth-flows estimand (Wall 1).

records.title: Remittances and fertility in Jamaica
records.reason: Operative variable is an intergenerational/cross-border transfer flow, not exposure to an external family model (Wall 1).

records.title: Long-run Impacts of Forced Labor Migration on Fertility Behaviors: Evidence from Colonial West Africa
records.reason: Colonial exposure works through mode of production and reduced need for child labour, with empowerment and human capital ruled out (Wall 1)

records.title: More remittances, fewer kids—Impact of remittances on fertility in Morocco
records.reason: Operative variable is a monetary transfer flow acting through income and human-capital accumulation, not an imported family model.

records.title: Another Gendered Demographic Dividend: Adjusting to a Future without Sons
records.reason: Outcome is old-age support expectations, an intergenerational-transfer variable, and the direction runs from fertility outcomes to attitudes.

records.title: Son Preference and Children's Housework: The Case of India
records.reason: Operative outcome is children's labour contribution within the household, a flow variable, with no fertility estimand.

records.title: Rural Agricultural Change and Fertility Transition in <scp>N</scp>epal
records.reason: Operative variable is demand for child farm labour; wealth-flows estimand under Wall 1.

records.title: Marriage as women's old age insurance : evidence from migration and land inheritance practices in rural Tanzania
records.reason: Operative variable is old-age support/security through inheritance transfers (Wall 1).

records.title: Adolescents’ Value of Children and Their Intentions to Have Children: A Cross-Cultural and Multilevel Analysis
records.reason: Value-of-children instrument measuring the utility children provide to parents, not a belief about or exposure to an external modern family model (Wall 1).

records.title: Useful and Priceless Children in Contemporary Welfare States
records.reason: Historical sociology of children's work and usefulness — a flow-of-contribution argument, Wall 1 routes to C.3.f.

records.title: On Net Intergenerational Wealth Flows: An Update
records.reason: Explicit restatement of the net-wealth-flows mechanism, which routes to C.3.f.

records.title: Fertility Transition in South and Southeast Asia
records.reason: Reviews the shift of children from economic assets to liabilities via production costs, a structural/wealth-flows mechanism rather than an ideational one.

records.title: Evolutionary demography and intrahousehold time allocation: School attendance and child labor among the Okavango Delta Peoples of Botswana
records.reason: Child labour contribution and intrahousehold transfers are the operative variables (Wall 1).

records.title: The co-evolution of human fertility and wealth inheritance strategies
records.reason: Operative variable is intergenerational wealth transfer and parental investment cost, which is the wealth-flows estimand (Wall 1).

records.title: The influence of structural change in agriculture on childbearing among Iowa's farm population
records.reason: Explicitly a wealth-flow-theory analysis of farm production structure and family labour, with the operative variable a productive/intergenerational flow rather than a family ideal.

records.title: Education, Tradition, and Household Labor among Rendille Pastoralists of Northern Kenya
records.reason: Operative variable is children's household labour contribution interpreted through the wealth-flows model (Wall 1), and the outcome is schooling allocation, not fertility.

records.title: Darwinian Transitions?: A Comment
records.reason: Theoretical comment whose operative variable is Caldwell's wealth-flows/kin-support transfers, which Wall 1 routes hard to C.3.f.

records.title: Welfare and Management of Demographic Uncertainty
records.reason: Operative variable is intergenerational transfers and the old-age security value of children (Wall 1).

records.title: The Modern Demographic Transition: An Analysis of Subsistence Choices and Reproductive Consequences
records.reason: Explicitly an extension of Caldwell's wealth-flows model with expected intergenerational income flows as the operative variable (Wall 1).

records.title: The Direction of Intergenerational Transfers and Demographic Transition: The Caldwell Hypothesis Reexamined
records.reason: Operative variable is the direction of intergenerational wealth flows — Wall 1 routes to C.3.f.

records.title: An Anthropological Approach to the Study of the Economic Value of Children in Java and Nepal [and Comments and Reply]
records.reason: Operative variable is the child-to-parent flow (labour input, coresidence, old-age support), which is the wealth-flows estimand (Wall 1).

records.title: The Economic Activities of Children in a Village in Bangladesh
records.reason: Operative variable is the intergenerational flow of child production and consumption; Wall 1 routes to C.3.f.

records.title: The economic rationality of high fertility: An investigation illustrated with Nigerian survey data
records.reason: Operative variable is the economic advantage children confer on parents, despite the closing westernization-versus-modernization claim (Wall 1).
